title: Two Methods for Decellularization of Plant Tissues for Tissue Engineering Applications
protocol: Use fresh or frozen F. hispida leaf samples.
Freeze unused fresh samples in a -20°C freezer and store for future use.
Determine the size and shape of samples based on their intended use.
Cut the leaf into 8 mm discs with a sharp, clean biopsy punch while submerged under room temperature deionized H2O.
Incubate the samples for 5-10 min at room temperature in deionized H2O on a shake plate set to a low speed setting.
Prepare a solution of 10% (w/v) sodium dodecyl sulfate (SDS) in deionized H2O.
Place the samples in a suitable container and add SDS solution to completely cover the samples.
Incubate samples for 5 days at room temperature on a shake plate set to a low speed.
Do not overcrowd the container during decellularization.
Replace the SDS solution with deionized H2O after 5 days.
Incubate samples for an additional 10-15 min on the shake plate to rinse off residual SDS solution.
Prepare a 1% (v/v) non-ionic surfactant in 10% (v/v) bleach solution by mixing 5 mL of the non-ionic surfactant with 50 mL of bleach and adding 445 mL of deionized H2O to make a 500 mL solution.
Submerge samples in the freshly prepared non-ionic surfactant/bleach solution.
Replace the non-ionic surfactant/bleach solution every 24 h until samples are completely cleared.
Incubate samples in deionized water on a shake plate for 2 min to rinse off excess non-ionic surfactant/bleach solution.
Set the shake plate to a low setting to prevent damaging the samples.
Reconstitute lyophilized samples in Tris-HCl buffer at a concentration sufficient to coat the samples.
Rinse reconstituted samples 2-3 times with serum-free media using a micropipette.
Prepare a 5% (v/v) bleach and 3% (w/v) sodium bicarbonate solution.
Warm the prepared solution in a fume hood to 60-70 °C for leaf samples while stirring.
Submerge the samples once they reach the desired temperature range.
Reduce the stirring speed to avoid damaging the samples.
Remove the samples from the bath carefully when they are visibly cleared.
Incubate the samples in deionized H2O for 1-2 min to remove excess bleach solution.
Lyophilize the samples after incubation.
Store the lyophilized samples at room temperature (20-25 °C) in low humidity.
